4. World Almanac/NPCs/Izek Strazni (COS).text: Izek survived the fall of Castle Ravenloft and was claimed by Vecna's power in that moment; the party freed him from Vecna's control (S49).

4. World Almanac/NPCs/Marrow.md.text: Marrow carries a soul-graft, the Marrow-rite, built from the same Eludrax soul-craft as the Amber Wardens, which lets it borrow a disguise target's trained reflexes and muscle memory.
The ambush on Roark and Lyssandra was opportunistic: the Ascendency had no advance knowledge of Corwin Vantor's detection device.
